title: Roll out Amazon Bedrock model settings with AWS AppConfig and AWS Lambda
description: AWS AppConfig rolls out Amazon Bedrock model and prompt settings to an AWS Lambda function gradually and rolls back on an Amazon CloudWatch alarm.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: An AWS AppConfig AI model invocation configuration profile holds the Amazon Bedrock model ID, inference parameters and system prompt. AWS AppConfig validates every version against the AI model invocation schema.
An AWS Lambda function reads the deployed configuration through the AWS AppConfig Agent Lambda extension and maps it onto an Amazon Bedrock Converse request.
A new version is rolled out with a gradual deployment strategy. An Amazon CloudWatch alarm on the function's errors is an environment monitor, so AWS AppConfig rolls a bad version back automatically.
The function role may invoke only two Amazon Nova models, so calls with a version that names another model fail, and those errors during the rollout trigger the rollback.
